anomalies.observed: U4 pin 3 (T+) and J3 pin 2 are both connected to the +3V3 net. There is no dedicated net connecting J3 pin 2 to U4 pin 3.
anomalies.expected: U4 pin 3 (T+) should connect directly to J3 pin 2, isolated from the +3V3 supply, as the other thermocouple channels do (J1.2–U2.3, J2.2–U3.3).

evidence.quote: Thermocouple wire pair connects to a 2-pin screw terminal (J1 for U2, J2 for U3, J3 for U4) whose two pins wire directly to the MAX31855's differential thermocouple inputs T+ (pin 3) and T- (pin 2).

anomalies.impact: The third thermocouple channel (U4/J3) is nonfunctional. T+ is tied to 3.3V, so the MAX31855 will read an invalid differential voltage and likely report a fault. J3 pin 2 also presents 3.3V on the thermocouple connector, which could damage the thermocouple or the MAX31855 if connected. Firmware will see a thermocouple fault for zone 3 and abort runs.
